INTERTEXTUALITY IN THE PRESENTATION OF THE THEME OF VIOLENCE IN THE NOVEL MSICHANA WA MBALAMWEZI BY K.W. WAMITILA. Authors of the modern Swahili novel convey messages to the audience by focusing on experimental literary techniques. Intertextuality is one of the key elements of those experimental techniques. The novels themselves have been called “experimental novels” or “modern novels.” Other experts have classified them as “Twenty-First Century novels.” The author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila is one of the modern writers who employs this new writing style to address various issues affecting society. The theory of postmodernism has guided this research in the analysis of the aspect of intertextuality. Various types of texts referenced in the presentation of the theme of violence were identified and explained. The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi was deliberately selected because it is presented through numerous short narratives that reference different texts. The descriptive content analysis method was used to analyze the data related to the overall issue of intertextuality. The data was analyzed by focusing on themes, settings, and key elements of experimental writing techniques. The findings were presented descriptively. It was revealed that a lack of order in the conduct of affairs is the true reflection of today's society. The referenced texts have shown that the ordinary citizen has been oppressed and provided with poor services by the leaders. This article has examined and evaluated how the author uses the technique of intertextuality as a device for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. Janice M. Introduction:- 1.1 Introduction This article addresses the issue of intertextuality as a tool for presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi (2011) by Kyallo Wadi Wamitila. The main objective is to identify the various types of texts referenced in the effort to present the theme of oppression. Regarding these matters, the article has demonstrated how the modern Swahili novel portrays a comprehensive image of today's society. This has been discussed within the framework of modern literary theory. Address:–Egerton University, Kenya. 1.2 Summary of the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi The main character in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is Yosi Kanga. He has had a good job and a good life. One day, things changed for her soon after she celebrated her thirty-fifth birthday. Yosi Kanga left the office at one o’clock for the afternoon break. She lay down in the garden, and soon sleep carried her away. He had a dream in which he was in danger. In that dream, a certain girl whom he knew as the msichana wa mbalamwezi saved him. He went to get lunch at a hotel near the headquarters of the Kenya Railways Corporation. After lunch, he suddenly collapses and falls ill. He was taken to City Breeze Hospital and admitted there. The doctor said that Yosi Kanga had a tumor in his head and, because of that, he had a short time to live. The services in the hospital were not good. The doctors and some of the staff mistreated the patients. Many of those patients died in ways that were not understood. Later, a female doctor visited her. The moment he saw her, Yosi was overcome by a certain feeling. He tried to remember where he had seen that doctor before. The doctor checked on his condition and after a brief conversation decided to break the news to him. Examinations and all ECG scan reports showed that Yosi was in good health. The doctor instructed him to prepare to leave the hospital. Yosi was very happy because the “death sentence” he had been given in the hospital was revoked. So this was his savior, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.  
1.3 Modernism  
The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is written on the foundations of modernism. The main element of modernism is the violation of realist writing conventions. Instead of adhering to the realist framework, the author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, as a modern writer, has written this novel based on new realism. Rettova (2016) has described Wamitila as a writer who leans towards modernism because he values the use of experimental techniques. Intertextuality is a key element in the perspective of modernist writing. Scholars have noted that it is difficult to draw boundaries between modernity and modernism. Modernity refers to a period in the history of literature that was closely tied to changes in the arts, especially between the 1880s and 1930s in Europe. At that time, human beings demonstrated their ability and power to create, strengthen, and shape their environment through new scientific, technological, and experimental methods (Best et al., 2001). These changes arose from the fact that, in the past, literature was dominated by religion and politics. The artistic changes involved literary genres such as poetry, drama, novels, dance, and film. Core themes, authentic language, realism, and a coherent structure are the key aspects that have been emphasized. European cities that witnessed these changes include Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, and Moscow. These changes were called Modernity and were the core and foundation of modernism. Abrams (1993) maintains that modernity is used to describe and identify new features of themes, genres, concepts, and literary styles associated with the first decades of the twentieth century, that is, after the Second World War. Abrams further emphasizes that the characteristics referred to vary depending on the critics involved. Wamitila (2007) states, “Despite these differences, most critics agree that the foundation of these features is a departure from the traditional foundations of art and Western or pre-existing culture.” According to this, it is evident that modernity completely broke away from the conventions of literary composition that were followed before the twentieth century. Although the exact time of the emergence of modernity and modernism is a matter of debate, it is clear that modernism arose and was built on the foundations of modernity. Modernism emerged and was established in the twentieth century. It was associated with Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, among others. Other scholars who have contributed to the theory of modernism include Jurgen Habermas (1987), who emphasizes that the contemporary world relies more on aspects of modernism, in which all activities related to modern human beings are examined through multiple narratives. A recent interpreter of this theory is Fredric Jameson (1991). This article focuses on various views of the theory as established by Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), and others. Lyotard (1984) maintains the controversial theory that the consciousness of members of society has been greatly transformed by the changes brought about by the industrial development period. This situation has led society to change its cultures and embrace modernist cultures. The modernist period disrupted the boundaries established by traditional culture. This phenomenon has manifested in various aspects of society, including literature. Life and people are not orderly, and therefore literary works should not have any particular order. Modernism is closely associated with popular culture, where people do things in whatever way they wish without following traditional norms. The writer gives himself permission to use another artist’s work to create a new one. With regard to these issues, this article has identified the types of texts referenced by the author K.W. Wamitila in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi to present the theme of oppression. Furthermore, it has analyzed how these texts were used in conveying the theme of oppression. This research focused on the aspect of intertextuality. Carter (2006) explains that modernism violates all conventions and rules of composition. The rules Carter refers to may be structural or linguistic. This is to say that, along with popular literature, modernism is also associated with popular performance. One well-known feature in popular literature is the “stream of consciousness,” which is a narrative technique in prose writing that employs lengthy descriptions focusing on the thoughts passing through a character’s mind (Wamitila, 2006). This performance takes place anywhere and does not follow any particular order. Often, the writer’s main goal is simply to entertain society. Popular performance uses popular language. Since language is an important tool in literary writing, modernism focuses on the use of language in a very free manner without adhering to its fluency or standardization. It also involves mixing different languages, for example, English and Swahili or first languages and Swahili. This concept guided this research in analyzing specific issues concerning the use of popular language, especially code-mixing and code-switching in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. The language used refers to various texts that present the theme of oppression in society. The foundation of modernism was employed to guide the research in the analysis of intertextuality as one of the key elements of experimental novels. The researcher has identified how this element disrupts order in the selected novel. 1.4 Intertextuality

Intertextuality is the translation of the English term “intertextuality,” which was first used by the French philosopher Julia Kristeva in her book ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). According to Kristeva, every word is a reference to other words. Thus, emphasis is placed on the idea that texts are related to and depend on one another to create meaning. Stam (2000), as quoted in Anderson (2004:1), states, “Any emerging text must inevitably coexist with another, or with other texts with which the original has also coexisted.” This statement demonstrates that a literary work does not originate solely from the mind of the author or from a vacuum, but is instead a collection of different texts. (Anderson, 2004) claims that intertextuality involves “that which has already been said.” Intertextuality is an important element of modernism, in which Wamitila writes. In addition, intertextuality is one of the key elements of experimental writing. The intertextuality that frequently appears in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is characterized by the use of short stories, branches of oral literature, philosophical opinions, poetry/songs, and language mixing. All these texts have been used in this novel to present the theme of oppression in various spheres of society such as health, education, and love. All these aspects interact and depend on each other in developing the creativity of the author. According to Julia Kristeva (1980), a text is related to other texts. This article has established that in presenting the theme of oppression in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, various texts are interconnected, interact, and depend on each other. Jilala (2016) explains that the meaning of one text is derived from other texts. In literature, meaning is represented by themes (Mohammed, 1995). Intertextuality in the selected novel has manifested at various levels such as form, characterization, motif, and themes. This article has identified the types of texts referenced in presenting the theme of oppression. Enani (2005) asserts that intertextuality influences the way a new text is read. The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi has demonstrated the presence of stylistic intermingling. Many of the references in this novel are of different styles and have influenced the narrative structure and plot. The audience is taken here and there. The reader starts reading one segment of the story, and before finishing it, another begins. This phenomenon results in complexity within the story itself. Wamitila (2010) asserts that this type of reference can lead to either negative or positive outcomes. Bakhtin (1981:271) argues that what is said is more than just the utterances themselves. Different contexts affect literary works in various ways. Contexts such as economic, social, or political factors influence certain relationships within literary works (Wamitila, 2010). Accordingly, this article has analyzed and critiqued the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, identifying the different types of contexts referenced, their relationships, and how those relationships contribute to presenting the theme of oppression. 1.5 Intertextual References and the Presentation of the Theme of Oppression in the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: A Modernist Perspective

Developing countries oppress their citizens in various ways. These methods are especially apparent in the manner in which services are delivered. For various reasons, which artists themselves may possess, such oppression is creatively presented through literature. To fully express this situation, narrative techniques and literary devices are employed with skill and artistry. The author K.W. Wamitila has used the element of intertextuality to illustrate the decay and oppression present in his society. This article has demonstrated how "ordinary" citizens are tormented by life in their country due to being deprived of essential services. This section has thoroughly explained the types of texts referenced by the author in his communication with society concerning oppression. 1.5.1 Philosophical Texts According to Lyotard (1997), postmodernism is based on the application of philosophical ideas in composition. Internal pressures and challenges are best understood when related to a particular philosophy or body of scholarship. However, philosophical texts can be complex for readers (Mwamzandi, 2013). The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is dominated by short narratives that refer to the opinions of philosophers. The philosophy of existentialism has led the author to accept that the oppression he experiences in the hospital is just one step in the journey toward his ultimate fate, which is death. The environment of the hospital where Yosi Kanga, the main character in this novel, was admitted was deplorable. The author notes that the beds were old. He describes this situation by saying, “…the metal frames were worn and had started to show patches of rust here and there, the thin sisal mattress was covered with a sheet that had lost its color and resembled a garment soaked in water, leaving stains all over.” (MWM. Ok. 25). The patient referred to had already been told by the doctor that they had a short time to live. Basically, even a patient in a critical condition needs to be given their human rights. The situation in the hospital disheartens him even more. This is because it oppresses him and denies him the right to quality care, even though he knew his fate was death. Moreover, he is oppressed emotionally to the point where he consoles himself with existential thoughts: “…I will rest when I am dead after a few days, and as our people say, the numbered days are few—they pass in the blink of an eye.” (MWM. p.48). According to Diegner (2005), the philosophy of existentialism holds that the ultimate fate of human beings is death. It does not matter whether she has a good job or not. Aside from having a good job that covered her medical expenses, the only solution for Yosi Kanga was death. 1.5.2. Religious texts (the Christian religion, indigenous religions) indicate that Yosi Kanga had health problems since the past which were caused by childhood accidents. Whenever she faced a problem, she was taken to the hospital on a stretcher with a wheel that made a lot of noise. Every time the neighbor's children heard the noise of that stretcher’s wheel, they knew Yosi was being taken to the hospital. Those children stood near the wire fence of their fruit farm and made mocking and derisive gestures at him. The author says, “I wished I had the power of the Biblical David. I would climb onto that cart, look for a wild tunguja fruit or perhaps even a pebble, and strike them on their foreheads to silence their Goliath” (MWM). Page. 21). Yosi saw the neighborhood children as the Goliath of the Bible, who oppressed and mocked the children of Israel. According to the Christian religion, Goliath's oppression of the Israelites was ended by a young boy, David, who slung a stone and killed him. Yosi wished that if he had the strength of David, he would silence those children who laughed at him and belittled him. Moreover, he likens their laughter to Goliath. Earlier, the character Konzi owned a hotel where he worked together with his wife. The author explains that Konzi used to mistreat women, but this habit ended when he got married. However, he continued to offend his wife by desiring other women who came to the hotel, right before his wife’s eyes. Konzi’s wife, whose name is Tabitha, views this behavior as disobedience to the Creator. The one being referred to as the Creator is Almighty God. For Tabitha, such abuse is an act of disobedience to one of the Ten Commandments of God, which warns against adultery as recorded in the Bible (Exodus 20). Tabitha retaliated against her husband by abusing him even more. The author says that Tabitha burst into loud laughter, turning this way and that as if seeking the companionship of others. Finally, she asked her husband whether he really knew her well. Tabitha ended by saying, “If you’re a snake, then I’m the master at drawing out its poison!” (MWM. p.51). The text referred to in this narrative is superstitious. The author Wamitila explains that after this strange event, Mr. Konzi was unable to pass stool or urinate. He was unable to reach the hotel again, “to see those women with faces like tomatoes or to spread butter on their bread” (MWM. Okay. 51). It is evident that his wife used witchcraft to bewitch her husband in an attempt to control him because of "external influences." Moreover, when Konzi was taken to Machakos General Hospital, the doctors were unable to help him. The writer says that even X-ray images did not show any problem. When his abdomen was examined with a stethoscope, the sound heard resembled a rooster crowing. He was advised by the doctor to return home, where his wife laughed and scolded him. Later, she gave him a light slap on the cheek, and the problem of the lump disappeared. It has been revealed that Tabitha used supernatural powers to punish anyone who disrespected her, especially her husband, Konzi. When a community lacks appropriate mechanisms for ensuring justice, it seeks its own means. In this context, the method used by Tabitha disrupts order and morality within the community. Normally, a wife takes care of and respects her husband in every way. 1.5.3 Academic Texts The doctor told the character Yosi Kanga that the health problem he was experiencing was caused by a swelling on his head. He went on to mention that he did not have many days left to live. The author uses the following words to describe this situation: “It seems… hmm… he has a problem of brain tumour… or even intracranial hypertension…! If my diagnosis is correct, because I have never been wrong in all my years of medical practice, he has about twenty-eight days to live… in fact it might even be less!” Academic texts have been used to torment Yosi mentally and emotionally. The examination was not conducted properly because it is later revealed that Yosi was in good health. The doctor boasted of being a scholar who had studied medicine at renowned institutions, “an alumnus of prestigious universities” (MWM). Yes. 31). Thus, when he spoke about his patient’s condition, Joseph knew and believed the truth that his days on earth had come to an end. 1.5.4 Political Texts  
The political situation often oppresses members of society. It has been observed that in many developing countries, politicians use young people to advance their own interests. The author of the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi narrates a story concerning soldiers. He explains that their faces reminded him of the “gangs of men” used by the wealthy to threaten their debtors (MWM). Page. 106). Similarly, the author narrates about the character Moylee Gaga, who bought a house in the Golden Gate neighborhood at an auction after the homeowner failed to pay his mortgage while still living inside. The homeowner needed to move out of the house that had gotten a new owner. The person who bought it did not know how to evict the occupant, so Moylee Gaga was advised to find a gang of youths, as politicians do, give them money to buy alcohol on Madongokuinama Street, then have them go there at night and throw out the homeowner’s belongings, regardless of the crying and shouting from his family (MWM). Uk. 106 – 107). Here, even though the homeowner failed to pay the mortgage, their eviction was carried out in a manner that was unjust and abusive. Another political term that was used is the word “operation” (MWM). Op. 107). This word illustrates how society suffers at the hands of those who are expected to protect it. Moylee Gaga is further advised, "just make sure that the chief of police in that area is aware—I think you understand me—that you simply have a certain 'operation'; as long as he knows, then you have absolutely nothing to fear." Everything will go smoothly. Political language is evident in the words and actions of the various actors mentioned in this context. Njogu (1987) found in his study that the lower class (those living in Madongokuinama) constantly fight against the elite. Contrary to this study, the oppressed appear to accept their situation. Moreover, they accept being “used” by the elite in exchange for small items such as alcohol. Those in power abuse their authority to harm others who are in the lower class. Extreme oppression is when the writer says that it is enough for the police chief to simply know about a certain “operation.” This is contrary to the expectations of the community. This is consistent with Kamunde’s (1983) observation that members of the lower class are oppressed by those of the upper class, although they eventually become aware of this and fight for their rights. 1.6 Conclusion  
This article has established that meaning, values, and truth are attained without relying on a single method or perspective, because their true source is society. Oppression in society has been presented through the use of intertextuality, which is an aspect of experimental writing. Various texts, including those of a philosophical, religious, academic, and political nature, have been used to convey the theme of oppression in the novel *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*. The author has used short narratives with specific intertextual references to illustrate how members of the community are denied their rights. Similarly, it has become evident that the lack of order in modern life is reflected in modern literature. However, although the disorder in carrying out various activities may appear inadequate, it is sufficient in literature. This inadequacy is in fact a true representation of modern life, that is, a complete image of today’s society. The current Swahili novel is appropriate because it serves as a true reflection of today’s society. It has become evident that short narratives referring to different texts are effective in presenting themes, rather than using a single long story written in the style of realism. Any creator has the freedom to try new methods in carrying out their work without being restricted or fixated on traditional rules. Therefore, a writer of literary works has the freedom to experiment with new approaches to writing without being constrained by traditional techniques that are rooted in realism. However, there is a risk that reading and understanding the modern novel requires prior knowledge of many issues related to philosophy, various disciplines, religion, politics, popular language, and others. Ilifichuliwa kwamba ukosefu wa mpangilio katika uendeshaji wa mambo ndio kielelezo halisi cha jamii ya leo. Matini yaliyorejelewa yameonyesha kwamba raia wa kawaida amekuwa akionyanyaswa na kupewa huduma duni na viongozi. Anwani:–Chuo Kikuu cha Egerton, Kenya. 1.2 Muhtasari wa Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi Mhusika mkuu katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ni Yosi Kanga. Amekuwa na kazi nzuri na maisha mazuri. Siku moja, mambo yalibadilika kwake muda mfupi baada ya kusherehekea siku yake ya kuzaliwa ya thelathini na tano. Yosi Kanga aliacha ofisini saa saba kwa ajili ya mapumziko ya mchana. Alilala chini bustanini, na muda mfupi baadaye usingizi ulimchukua. Alikuwa na ndoto ambayo alikuwa hatarini. Katika ndoto hiyo, msichana fulani aliyemfahamu kama msichana wa mbalamwezi alimwokoa. Alienda kuchukua chakula cha mchana katika hoteli iliyo karibu na makao makuu ya Shirika la Reli la Kenya. Baada ya chakula cha mchana, ghafla anaanguka na kuugua. Alichukuliwa kwenda Hospitali ya City Breeze na kulazwa hapo. Daktari alisema kwamba Yosi Kanga alikuwa na uvimbe kichwani mwake na, kwa sababu hiyo, alikuwa na muda mfupi wa kuishi. Huduma katika hospitali hazikuwa nzuri. Madaktari na baadhi ya wafanyakazi waliwadhulumu wagonjwa. Wengi wa wagonjwa hao walikufa kwa njia ambazo hazikueleweka. Baadaye, daktari mwanamke alimtazama. Mara tu alipomuona, Yosi alishikwa na hisia fulani. Alijaribu kukumbuka ni wapi alikuwa amewahi kumuona yule daktari hapo awali. Daktari alikagua hali yake na baada ya mazungumzo mafupi aliamua kumpa habari. Mitihani na ripoti zote za uchunguzi wa ECG zilionyesha kwamba Yosi alikuwa na afya njema. Daktari alimwagiza ajiandae kuondoka hospitalini. Yosi alifurahi sana kwa sababu “hukumu ya kifo” aliyokuwa amepewa hospitalini ilifutwa. Hivyo basi huyu ndiye alikuwa mkombozi wake, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.  
1.3 Ushawishi wa Kisasa  
Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeandikwa kwa misingi ya uasasa. Kipengele kikuu cha uasasa ni kuvunja miiko ya uandishi wa kimapokeo. Badala ya kushikilia mfumo wa uhalisia, mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, kama mwandishi wa kisasa, ameandika riwaya hii kwa misingi ya uhalisia mpya. Rettova (2016) amemwelezea Wamitila kama mwandishi anayeelemea upande wa ujanari kwa sababu anathamini matumizi ya mbinu za majaribio. Ughusiano wa maandishi ni kipengele muhimu katika mtazamo wa uandishi wa kisasa. Wanazuoni wamebaini kwamba ni vigumu kuweka mipaka kati ya ukisasa na usasa. Ukisasa unarejelea kipindi katika historia ya fasihi ambacho kilikuwa karibu sana na mabadiliko katika sanaa, hasa kati ya miaka ya 1880 na 1930 barani Ulaya. Wakati huo, binadamu walionyesha uwezo na nguvu zao za kuunda, kuimarisha, na kuunda mazingira yao kupitia mbinu mpya za kisayansi, kiteknolojia, na majaribio (Best et al., 2001). Mabadiliko haya yalitokana na ukweli kwamba, zamani, fasihi ilitawaliwa na dini na siasa. Mabadiliko ya kisanii yalihusisha aina za fasihi kama vile mashairi, tamthilia, riwaya, ngoma, na filamu. Mada kuu, lugha halisi, uhalisia, na muundo thabiti ndiyo mambo muhimu yaliyopewa kipaumbele. Miji ya Ulaya iliyoshuhudia mabadiliko haya ni pamoja na Paris, Vienna, Roma, London, na Moscow. Mabadiliko haya yaliitwa Umagharibi na yalikuwa msingi na nguzo ya usasa. Abrams (1993) anasisitiza kwamba uandishi wa kisasa hutumika kuelezea na kubainisha sifa mpya za dhamira, aina, dhana, na mitindo ya kifasihi inayohusishwa na miongo ya kwanza ya karne ya ishirini, yaani, baada ya Vita vya Pili vya Dunia. Abrams anaongeza kuwa sifa zinazorejelewa hubadilika kulingana na wakosoaji wanaohusika. Wamitila (2007) anasema, “Licha ya tofauti hizi, wakosoaji wengi wanakubaliana kwamba msingi wa sifa hizi ni kuondoka kutoka kwa misingi ya jadi ya sanaa na utamaduni wa Magharibi au uliokuwepo awali.” Kulingana na hili, ni wazi kwamba usasa ulijitenga kabisa na mila za uandishi wa fasihi zilizofuatwa kabla ya karne ya ishirini. Ingawa wakati halisi wa kuzuka kwa usasa na usanifu wa kisasa ni suala lenye mjadala, ni dhahiri kwamba usanifu wa kisasa uliibuka na kujengwa juu ya misingi ya usasa. Usanifu wa kisasa uliibuka na kuthibitishwa katika karne ya ishirini. Ilihusishwa na Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, miongoni mwa wengine. Wanazuoni wengine ambao wamechangia kwenye nadharia ya umoderinishaji ni pamoja na Jurgen Habermas (1987), ambaye anasisitiza kwamba ulimwengu wa kisasa unategemea zaidi vipengele vya umoderinishaji, ambamo shughuli zote zinazohusiana na binadamu wa kisasa zinachunguzwa kupitia simulizi nyingi. Mfafanuzi wa hivi karibuni wa nadharia hii ni Fredric Jameson (1991). Makala hii inazingatia mitazamo mbalimbali ya nadharia hii kama ilivyoanzishwa na Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), na wengine. Lyotard (1984) anashikilia nadharia yenye utata kwamba fahamu za wanajamii zimebadilika sana kutokana na mabadiliko yaliyoletwa na kipindi cha maendeleo ya viwanda. Hali hii imesababisha jamii kubadili tamaduni zake na kukumbatia tamaduni za kimodernisti. Kipindi cha umoderani kilivuruga mipaka iliyowekwa na utamaduni wa jadi. Jambo hili limejitokeza katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii, ikiwa ni pamoja na fasihi. Maisha na watu si wa mpangilio, na hivyo kazi za fasihi hazipaswi kuwa na mpangilio maalum. Umoderno umehusishwa kwa karibu na utamaduni maarufu, ambapo watu hufanya mambo kwa njia yoyote wanayotaka bila kufuata desturi za jadi. Mwandishi anajipa ruhusa ya kutumia kazi ya msanii mwingine kuunda kazi mpya. Kuhusiana na masuala haya, makala hii imetambua aina za maandishi yaliyotajwa na mwandishi K.W. Wamitila katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ili kuwasilisha dhamira ya uonevu. Zaidi ya hayo, imeshughulikia jinsi maandishi haya yalivyotumika katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya uonevu. Utafiti huu umejikita katika kipengele cha mtindo wa maandishi mbalimbali (intertextuality). Carter (2006) anaeleza kuwa uanamitindo wa kisasa unakiuka kanuni na sheria zote za uundaji. Sheria ambazo Carter anazirejelea zinaweza kuwa za kimuundo au za lugha. Hii ni kusema kwamba, pamoja na fasihi maarufu, usasa pia unahusishwa na uigizaji maarufu. Kipengele kimoja kinachojulikana sana katika fasihi maarufu ni "mto wa fikra," ambacho ni mbinu ya uandishi wa tamthilia inayotumia maelezo marefu yanayolenga mawazo yanayopita katika akili ya mhusika (Wamitila, 2006). Onyesho hili hufanyika mahali popote na halifuati mpangilio maalum wowote. Mara nyingi, lengo kuu la mwandishi ni kuburudisha jamii tu. Utendaji maarufu hutumia lugha maarufu. Kwa kuwa lugha ni chombo muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi, usasa unalenga matumizi ya lugha kwa njia huru sana bila kuzingatia ufasaha au viwango vyake. Pia unahusisha uchanganyaji wa lugha mbalimbali, kwa mfano, Kiingereza na Kiswahili au lugha za kwanza na Kiswahili. Dhana hii iliongoza utafiti huu kuchunguza masuala mahususi kuhusu matumizi ya lugha maarufu, hasa uchanganyaji lugha na ubadilishaji wa msimbo katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. Lugha iliyotumiwa inarejelea maandishi mbalimbali yanayowasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji katika jamii. Msingi wa usasa ulitumiwa kuongoza utafiti katika uchambuzi wa uhusiano wa maandishi kama mojawapo ya vipengele muhimu vya riwaya za majaribio. Mtafiti ametambua jinsi kipengele hiki kinavyovuruga mpangilio katika riwaya iliyoteuliwa. 1.4 Intertekstualiti

Intertekstualiti ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza “intertextuality,” ambalo lilitumiwa kwanza na mwanafalsafa wa Kifaransa Julia Kristeva katika kitabu chake ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). Kwa mujibu wa Kristeva, kila neno ni rejea kwa maneno mengine. Hivyo, msisitizo umewekwa kwenye wazo kwamba maandishi yanahusiana na kutegemeana ili kuunda maana. Stam (2000), kama alivyonukuliwa katika Anderson (2004:1), anasema, “Kila maandishi yanayochipuka lazima yaishi pamoja na maandishi mengine, au na maandishi mengine ambayo ya awali pia yameishi pamoja nayo.” Kauli hii inaonyesha kwamba kazi ya fasihi haitokani tu na akili ya mwandishi au kwenye ombwe, bali ni mkusanyiko wa maandishi tofauti tofauti. (Anderson, 2004) anadai kwamba maandishi yanahusisha “kile ambacho tayari kimesemwa.” Maandishi ni kipengele muhimu cha usasa, ambapo Wamitila anaandika. Zaidi ya hayo, mwingiliano wa maandishi ni mojawapo ya vipengele muhimu vya uandishi wa majaribio. Mwingiliano wa maandishi unaojitokeza mara kwa mara katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi unajulikana kwa matumizi ya hadithi fupi, matawi ya fasihi simulizi, maoni ya kifalsafa, mashairi/nyimbo, na uchanganyaji wa lugha. Maandishi haya yote yametumika katika riwaya hii kuwasilisha mada ya ukandamizaji katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii kama vile afya, elimu, na mapenzi. Mambo haya yote huingiliana na kutegemeana katika kuendeleza ubunifu wa mwandishi. Kulingana na Julia Kristeva (1980), maandishi yanahusiana na maandishi mengine. Makala haya yamebainisha kwamba katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji kwenye riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, maandishi mbalimbali yanaunganishwa, yanashirikiana, na yanategemeana. Jilala (2016) anaeleza kuwa maana ya maandishi moja inatokana na maandishi mengine. Katika fasihi, maana inawakilishwa na mada (Mohammed, 1995). Uhusiano wa matini katika riwaya iliyochaguliwa umejitokeza katika viwango mbalimbali kama vile mtindo, uhusika, motif, na mada. Makala hii imetambua aina za maandishi yaliyorejelewa katika kuwasilisha mada ya uonevu. Enani (2005) anasisitiza kuwa mwingiliano wa maandishi unaathiri jinsi maandishi mapya yanavyosomwa. Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeonyesha uwepo wa mchanganyiko wa mitindo. Marejeleo mengi katika riwaya hii ni ya mitindo tofauti na yameathiri muundo wa simulizi na msuko wa hadithi. Hadhira inapelekwa hapa na pale. Msomaji anaanza kusoma sehemu moja ya hadithi, na kabla hajamaliza, nyingine inaanza. Jambo hili husababisha ugumu ndani ya hadithi yenyewe. Wamitila (2010) anadai kwamba aina hii ya marejeleo inaweza kusababisha matokeo hasi au chanya. Bakhtin (1981:271) anasema kwamba kile kinachosemwa ni zaidi ya matamshi yenyewe. Muktadha tofauti huathiri kazi za fasihi kwa njia mbalimbali. Muktadha kama vile hali za kiuchumi, kijamii, au kisiasa huathiri uhusiano fulani ndani ya kazi za fasihi (Wamitila, 2010). Kwa hivyo, makala haya yamechambua na kuchambua riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi, ikitambua aina tofauti za muktadha zilizotajwa, uhusiano wao, na jinsi mahusiano hayo yanavyochangia katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji. 1.5 Marejeleo ya Kimitindo na Uwasilishaji wa Mada ya Ukandamizaji katika Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: Mtazamo wa Kiumodernisti

Nchi zinazoendelea zinawakandamiza raia wao kwa njia mbalimbali. Mbinu hizi zinaonekana wazi hasa katika namna huduma zinavyotolewa. Kwa sababu mbalimbali, ambazo wasanii wenyewe huenda wanazo, ukandamizaji huu huwasilishwa kwa ubunifu kupitia fasihi. Ili kuelezea hali hii kikamilifu, mbinu za kifasihi na mbinu za simulizi hutumiwa kwa ustadi na ubunifu. Mwandishi K.W. Wamitila ametumia kipengele cha uandishi wa maandishi yanayohusiana ili kuonesha uozo na ukandamizwaji uliopo katika jamii yake. Makala hii imeonyesha jinsi raia "wa kawaida" wanavyoteswa na maisha katika nchi yao kutokana na kunyimwa huduma muhimu. Sehemu hii imeelezea kwa kina aina za maandishi yaliyorejelewa na mwandishi katika mawasiliano yake na jamii kuhusu ukandamizaji. 1.5.1 Maandishi ya Kifalsafa Kulingana na Lyotard (1997), usasa wa baada unatokana na matumizi ya mawazo ya kifalsafa katika uandishi. Shinikizo na changamoto za ndani hueleweka vyema zinapohusishwa na falsafa fulani au mkusanyiko wa usomi. Hata hivyo, maandishi ya kifalsafa yanaweza kuwa magumu kwa wasomaji (Mwamzandi, 2013). Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi inatawaliwa na hadithi fupi ambazo zinarejelea maoni ya wanafalsafa. Falsafa ya uegzistenshalizimu imemfanya mwandishi kukubali kwamba uonevu anaoapata hospitalini ni hatua moja tu katika safari kuelekea hatima yake ya mwisho, ambayo ni kifo. Mazingira ya hospitali ambako Yosi Kanga, mhusika mkuu katika riwaya hii, alilazwa yalikuwa ya kusikitisha. Mwandishi anabainisha kwamba vitanda vilikuwa vya zamani. Anaelezea hali hii kwa kusema, “…fremu za chuma zilikuwa zimechakaa na zilianza kuonyesha madoa ya kutu hapa na pale, godoro jembamba la mkonge lilikuwa limefunikwa na shuka iliyopoteza rangi na kufanana na vazi lililolowa majini, na kuacha madoa kila mahali.” (MWM. Sawa. Ishirini na tano). Mgonjwa aliyerejelewa alikuwa tayari ameambiwa na daktari kwamba ana muda mfupi wa kuishi. Kimsingi, hata mgonjwa aliye katika hali mbaya anahitaji kupewa haki zake za kibinadamu. Hali iliyo hospitalini inamvunja moyo hata zaidi. Hii ni kwa sababu inamnyanyasa na kumnyima haki ya kupata huduma bora, ijapokuwa alijua hatima yake ilikuwa kifo. Zaidi ya hayo, ananyanyasika kihisia hadi kufikia kujifariji kwa mawazo ya kuwepo: “…nitapumzika nitakapokufa baada ya siku chache, na kama watu wetu wasemavyo, siku zilizohesabiwa ni chache—zinapita kwa mng’ao wa jicho.” (MWM. uk.48). Kulingana na Diegner (2005), falsafa ya uwepo inashikilia kwamba hatima ya mwisho ya wanadamu ni kifo. Haijalishi kama ana kazi nzuri au la. Mbali na kuwa na kazi nzuri iliyogharamia matibabu yake, suluhisho pekee kwa Yosi Kanga lilikuwa kifo. 1.5.2. Maandiko ya kidini (dini ya Kikristo, dini za jadi) yanaonyesha kwamba Yosi Kanga alikuwa na matatizo ya afya tangu zamani ambayo yalitokana na ajali alizopata utotoni. Kila alipokumbana na tatizo, alipelekwa hospitalini kwenye machela yenye gurudumu lililotoa kelele nyingi. Kila mara watoto wa jirani waliposikia kelele ya gurudumu la machela hiyo, walijua Yosi alikuwa akipelekwa hospitalini. Watoto hao walisimama karibu na uzio wa waya wa shamba lao la matunda na kumfanyia ishara za kejeli na dhihaka. Mwandishi anasema, "Nilitamani ningekuwa na nguvu za Daudi wa Biblia. Ningepanda kwenye gari hilo, nitafute tunda la tunguja au hata jiwe dogo, na kuwapiga kwenye vipaji vya nyuso zao ili kunyamazisha Goliathi wao" (MWM). Ukurasa. 21). Yosi aliwaona watoto wa mtaa kama Goliathi wa Biblia, ambaye aliwatesa na kuwadhihaki watoto wa Israeli. Kulingana na dini ya Kikristo, ukandamizaji wa Goliathi dhidi ya Waisraeli ulikomeshwa na kijana mdogo, Daudi, ambaye alirusha jiwe na kumuua. Yosi alitamani kwamba kama angekuwa na nguvu za Daudi, angewanyamazisha wale watoto waliomcheka na kumdharau. Zaidi ya hayo, anafananisha kicheko chao na Goliathi. Hapo awali, mhusika Konzi alikuwa na hoteli ambapo alifanya kazi pamoja na mke wake. Mwandishi anaeleza kwamba Konzi alikuwa akiwatendea wanawake vibaya zamani, lakini tabia hii ilisimama alipooa. Hata hivyo, aliendelea kumkosea mkewe kwa kutamani wanawake wengine waliokuja kwenye hoteli, mbele ya macho ya mkewe. Mke wa Konzi, aitwaye Tabitha, anaona tabia hii kama uasi kwa Muumba. Anayerejelewa kuwa Muumba ni Mungu Mwenyezi. Kwa Tabitha, unyanyasaji wa aina hiyo ni kitendo cha kutotii mojawapo ya Amri Kumi za Mungu, ambayo inaonya dhidi ya uzinzi kama ilivyorekodiwa katika Biblia (Kutoka 20). Tabitha alimlipiza kisasi mumewe kwa kumnyanyasa zaidi. Mwandishi anasema kwamba Tabitha alicheka kwa sauti kubwa, akigeuka huku na kule kana kwamba anatafuta ushirika wa wengine. Hatimaye, alimwuliza mumewe ikiwa kweli anamjua vizuri. Tabitha alimaliza kwa kusema, "Kama wewe ni nyoka, basi mimi ndiye bwana wa kutoa sumu yake!" uk.51). Maandishi yaliyotajwa katika simulizi hii ni ya ushirikina. Mwandishi Wamitila anaeleza kwamba baada ya tukio hili la ajabu, Bwana Konzi hakuweza kujisaidia kinyesi wala kukojoa. Hakuweza kufika hoteli tena, "kuwaona wale wanawake wenye nyuso kama nyanya au kupaka siagi kwenye mkate wao" (MWM). Sawa. hamsini na moja). Ni wazi kwamba mke wake alitumia ushirikina kumroga mume wake kwa jitihada za kumdhibiti kutokana na "mvuto wa nje." Zaidi ya hayo, wakati Konzi alipelekwa Hospitali Kuu ya Machakos, madaktari hawakuweza kumsaidia. Mwandishi anasema kwamba hata picha za X-ray hazikuonyesha tatizo lolote. Wakati tumbo lake lilipokaguliwa kwa kutumia stethoscope, sauti iliyosikika ilifanana na kuchafuliwa kwa jogoo. Alipewa ushauri na daktari arudi nyumbani, ambako mkewe alicheka na kumkaripia. Baadaye, alimchapa kibao kidogo shavuni, na tatizo la uvimbe likatoweka. Imekuwa ikifunuliwa kwamba Tabitha alitumia nguvu za ajabu kuwaadhibu yeyote aliyemdharau, hasa mumewe, Konzi. Wakati jamii inakosa mifumo mwafaka ya kuhakikisha haki, inatafuta mbinu zake yenyewe. Katika muktadha huu, njia aliyotumia Tabitha inavuruga utaratibu na maadili ndani ya jamii. Kawaida, mke humtunza na kumheshimu mume wake kwa kila njia. 1.5.3 Maandishi ya Kitaaluma Daktari alimwambia mhusika Yosi Kanga kuwa tatizo la kiafya alilokuwa akipata lilisababishwa na uvimbe kichwani mwake. Aliendelea kutaja kwamba hakuwa na siku nyingi zilizobaki za kuishi. Mwandishi anatumia maneno yafuatayo kuelezea hali hii: “Inaonekana… hmm… ana tatizo la uvimbe wa ubongo… au hata shinikizo la juu ndani ya fuvu…! Ikiwa uchunguzi wangu ni sahihi, kwa sababu sijawahi kukosea katika miaka yangu yote ya utabibu, ana kama siku ishirini na nane za kuishi… kwa kweli huenda zisiwe hata nyingi hivyo!” Maandishi ya kitaaluma yametumiwa kumtesa Yosi kiakili na kihisia. Uchunguzi haukufanywa ipasavyo kwa sababu baadaye ilibainika kuwa Yosi alikuwa na afya nzuri. Daktari alijigamba kuwa msomi aliyesomea udaktari katika taasisi mashuhuri, “mzaliwa wa vyuo vikuu vya kifahari” (MWM). Ndiyo. Hivyo, alipozungumzia hali ya mgonjwa wake, Yosefu alijua na kuamini ukweli kwamba siku zake duniani zilikuwa zimefikia mwisho. Hali ya kisiasa mara nyingi inawakandamiza wanachama wa jamii. Imebainika kuwa katika mataifa mengi yanayoendelea, wanasiasa hutumia vijana kuendeleza maslahi yao binafsi. Mwandishi wa riwaya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi anasimulia hadithi kuhusu askari. Anaeleza kwamba nyuso zao zilimkumbusha “makundi ya wanaume” yaliyotumiwa na matajiri kuwatisha wadaiwa wao (MWM). Ukurasa. 106). Vivyo hivyo, mwandishi anasimulia kuhusu mhusika Moylee Gaga, ambaye alinunua nyumba katika mtaa wa Golden Gate kwenye mnada baada ya mmiliki wa nyumba kushindwa kulipa rehani yake huku bado akiendelea kuishi ndani. Mmiliki wa nyumba alihitaji kuhamia nje ya nyumba ambayo ilikuwa imepata mmiliki mpya. Mtu aliyelinunua hakujua jinsi ya kumfukuza mkazi, hivyo Moylee Gaga alishauriwa atafute kundi la vijana, kama wanasiasa wanavyofanya, awape pesa wanunue pombe katika Mtaa wa Madongokuinama, kisha waende huko usiku na kutupa mali za mwenye nyumba nje, bila kujali kilio na kelele kutoka kwa familia yake (MWM). Uingereza. 106 – 107). Hapa, ingawa mwenye nyumba alishindwa kulipa rehani, kufukuzwa kwake kulitokea kwa njia isiyo ya haki na ya kikatili. Neno jingine la kisiasa lililotumika ni neno "operesheni" (MWM). Op. 107). Neno hili linaonyesha jinsi jamii inavyoteseka mikononi mwa wale wanaotarajiwa kuilinda. Moylee Gaga anaonywa zaidi, "hakikisha tu kwamba mkuu wa polisi wa eneo hilo anafahamu—nafikiri unanielewa—kwamba una 'operesheni' fulani tu; mradi anajua, basi huna lolote la kuogopa." Kila kitu kitaenda vizuri. Lugha ya kisiasa inaonekana wazi katika maneno na matendo ya wahusika mbalimbali waliotajwa katika muktadha huu. Njogu (1987) aligundua katika utafiti wake kwamba tabaka la chini (wale wanaoishi Madongokuinama) hupigana mara kwa mara dhidi ya tabaka la juu. Kinyume na utafiti huu, waliodhulumiwa wanaonekana kukubali hali yao. Zaidi ya hayo, wanakubali "kutumiwa" na wasomi kwa kubadilishana na vitu vidogo kama vile pombe. Walioko madarakani wanatumia vibaya mamlaka yao kuwadhuru wengine walioko katika tabaka la chini. Ukandamizaji mkubwa ni pale mwandishi anaposema kuwa inatosha kwa mkuu wa polisi kujua tu kuhusu “operesheni” fulani. Hii ni kinyume na matarajio ya jamii. Hii inalingana na uchunguzi wa Kamunde (1983) kwamba wanachama wa tabaka la chini wanakandamizwa na wale wa tabaka la juu, ingawa hatimaye wanatambua hili na kupigania haki zao. 1.6 Hitimisho  
Makala haya imebainisha kwamba maana, maadili, na ukweli vinapatikana bila kutegemea mbinu au mtazamo mmoja pekee, kwa sababu chanzo chao halisi ni jamii. Ukandamizaji katika jamii umeoneshwa kupitia matumizi ya mwingiliano wa maandishi, ambao ni kipengele cha uandishi wa majaribio. Maandishi mbalimbali, yakiwemo ya kifalsafa, kidini, kitaaluma, na kisiasa, yametumika kuwasilisha mada ya ukandamizaji katika riwaya ya *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*. Mwandishi ametumia hadithi fupi zenye marejeo mahususi ya maandishi mengine ili kuonyesha jinsi wanajamii wanavyonyimwa haki zao. Vivyo hivyo, imekuwa dhahiri kwamba ukosefu wa utaratibu katika maisha ya kisasa unaonekana pia katika fasihi ya kisasa. Hata hivyo, ingawa vurugu katika utekelezaji wa shughuli mbalimbali inaweza kuonekana haitoshi, inatosha katika fasihi. Upungufu huu kwa hakika ni uwakilishi halisi wa maisha ya kisasa, yani picha kamili ya jamii ya leo. Riwaya ya Kiswahili ya sasa inafaa kwa sababu inaakisi kwa ukweli jamii ya leo. Imebainika kwamba hadithi fupi zinazoelezea maandishi mbalimbali zina ufanisi katika kuwasilisha dhamira, badala ya kutumia hadithi moja ndefu iliyoandikwa kwa mtindo wa uhalisia. Muumba yeyote ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya katika kutekeleza kazi yao bila kuzuiliwa au kushikamana na kanuni za jadi. Hivyo basi, mwandishi wa kazi za fasihi ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya za uandishi bila kufungwa na mbinu za jadi ambazo zina mizizi katika uhalisia. Hata hivyo, kuna hatari kwamba kusoma na kuelewa riwaya ya kisasa kunahitaji maarifa ya awali kuhusu masuala mengi yanayohusiana na falsafa, taaluma mbalimbali, dini, siasa, lugha maarufu, na mengineyo. discourses.source_txt: The descriptive content analysis method was used to analyze the data related to the overall issue of intertextuality. The data was analyzed by focusing on themes, settings, and key elements of experimental writing techniques. The findings were presented descriptively.
discourses.translated_txt: Mbinu ya uchanganuzi wa maudhui ya maelezo ilitumika kuchambua data zinazohusiana na suala la jumla la muingiliano wa maandishi. discourses.source_txt: Regarding these matters, the article has demonstrated how the modern Swahili novel portrays a comprehensive image of today's society. This has been discussed within the framework of modern literary theory.

discourses.source_txt: He has had a good job and a good life.

discourses.source_txt: One day, things changed for her soon after she celebrated her thirty-fifth birthday.
discourses.translated_txt: Siku moja, mambo yalibadilika kwake muda mfupi baada ya kusherehekea siku yake ya kuzaliwa ya thelathini na tano.

discourses.source_txt: Yosi Kanga left the office at one o’clock for the afternoon break. She lay down in the garden, and soon sleep carried her away.
discourses.translated_txt: Yosi Kanga aliacha ofisini saa saba kwa ajili ya mapumziko ya mchana. Alilala chini bustanini, na muda mfupi baadaye usingizi ulimchukua.

discourses.source_txt: He had a dream in which he was in danger. In that dream, a certain girl whom he knew as the msichana wa mbalamwezi saved him.
discourses.translated_txt: Alikuwa na ndoto ambayo alikuwa hatarini. Katika ndoto hiyo, msichana fulani aliyemfahamu kama msichana wa mbalamwezi alimwokoa.

discourses.source_txt: He went to get lunch at a hotel near the headquarters of the Kenya Railways Corporation.

discourses.source_txt: After lunch, he suddenly collapses and falls ill.
discourses.translated_txt: Baada ya chakula cha mchana, ghafla anaanguka na kuugua.

discourses.source_txt: He was taken to City Breeze Hospital and admitted there. The doctor said that Yosi Kanga had a tumor in his head and, because of that, he had a short time to live.
discourses.translated_txt: Alichukuliwa kwenda Hospitali ya City Breeze na kulazwa hapo. Daktari alisema kwamba Yosi Kanga alikuwa na uvimbe kichwani mwake na, kwa sababu hiyo, alikuwa na muda mfupi wa kuishi.

discourses.source_txt: The services in the hospital were not good. The doctors and some of the staff mistreated the patients. Many of those patients died in ways that were not understood.
discourses.translated_txt: Huduma katika hospitali hazikuwa nzuri. Madaktari na baadhi ya wafanyakazi waliwadhulumu wagonjwa. Wengi wa wagonjwa hao walikufa kwa njia ambazo hazikueleweka.

discourses.source_txt: Later, a female doctor visited her.
discourses.translated_txt: Baadaye, daktari mwanamke alimtazama.

discourses.source_txt: The moment he saw her, Yosi was overcome by a certain feeling. He tried to remember where he had seen that doctor before.
discourses.translated_txt: Mara tu alipomuona, Yosi alishikwa na hisia fulani. Alijaribu kukumbuka ni wapi alikuwa amewahi kumuona yule daktari hapo awali.

discourses.source_txt: The doctor checked on his condition and after a brief conversation decided to break the news to him.
discourses.translated_txt: Daktari alikagua hali yake na baada ya mazungumzo mafupi aliamua kumpa habari.

discourses.source_txt: Examinations and all ECG scan reports showed that Yosi was in good health.
discourses.translated_txt: Mitihani na ripoti zote za uchunguzi wa ECG zilionyesha kwamba Yosi alikuwa na afya njema.

discourses.source_txt: The doctor instructed him to prepare to leave the hospital. Yosi was very happy because the “death sentence” he had been given in the hospital was revoked.

1.3 Modernism  
The novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi is written on the foundations of modernism. The main element of modernism is the violation of realist writing conventions.
discourses.translated_txt:
Hivyo basi huyu ndiye alikuwa mkombozi wake, Msichana wa Mbalamwezi.  
1.3 Ushawishi wa Kisasa  
Riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi imeandikwa kwa misingi ya uasasa. Kipengele kikuu cha uasasa ni kuvunja miiko ya uandishi wa kimapokeo.

discourses.source_txt: Instead of adhering to the realist framework, the author Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, as a modern writer, has written this novel based on new realism.
discourses.translated_txt: Badala ya kushikilia mfumo wa uhalisia, mwandishi Kyallo Wadi Wamitila, kama mwandishi wa kisasa, ameandika riwaya hii kwa misingi ya uhalisia mpya.

discourses.source_txt: Rettova (2016) has described Wamitila as a writer who leans towards modernism because he values the use of experimental techniques.
discourses.translated_txt: Rettova (2016) amemwelezea Wamitila kama mwandishi anayeelemea upande wa ujanari kwa sababu anathamini matumizi ya mbinu za majaribio.

discourses.source_txt: Intertextuality is a key element in the perspective of modernist writing.
discourses.translated_txt: Ughusiano wa maandishi ni kipengele muhimu katika mtazamo wa uandishi wa kisasa.

discourses.source_txt: Scholars have noted that it is difficult to draw boundaries between modernity and modernism. Modernity refers to a period in the history of literature that was closely tied to changes in the arts, especially between the 1880s and 1930s in Europe.
discourses.translated_txt: Wanazuoni wamebaini kwamba ni vigumu kuweka mipaka kati ya ukisasa na usasa. Ukisasa unarejelea kipindi katika historia ya fasihi ambacho kilikuwa karibu sana na mabadiliko katika sanaa, hasa kati ya miaka ya 1880 na 1930 barani Ulaya.

discourses.source_txt: At that time, human beings demonstrated their ability and power to create, strengthen, and shape their environment through new scientific, technological, and experimental methods (Best et al., 2001).
discourses.translated_txt: Wakati huo, binadamu walionyesha uwezo na nguvu zao za kuunda, kuimarisha, na kuunda mazingira yao kupitia mbinu mpya za kisayansi, kiteknolojia, na majaribio (Best et al., 2001).

discourses.source_txt: These changes arose from the fact that, in the past, literature was dominated by religion and politics. The artistic changes involved literary genres such as poetry, drama, novels, dance, and film.
discourses.translated_txt: Mabadiliko haya yalitokana na ukweli kwamba, zamani, fasihi ilitawaliwa na dini na siasa. Mabadiliko ya kisanii yalihusisha aina za fasihi kama vile mashairi, tamthilia, riwaya, ngoma, na filamu.

discourses.source_txt: Core themes, authentic language, realism, and a coherent structure are the key aspects that have been emphasized.
discourses.translated_txt: Mada kuu, lugha halisi, uhalisia, na muundo thabiti ndiyo mambo muhimu yaliyopewa kipaumbele.

discourses.source_txt: European cities that witnessed these changes include Paris, Vienna, Rome, London, and Moscow. These changes were called Modernity and were the core and foundation of modernism.
discourses.translated_txt: Miji ya Ulaya iliyoshuhudia mabadiliko haya ni pamoja na Paris, Vienna, Roma, London, na Moscow. Mabadiliko haya yaliitwa Umagharibi na yalikuwa msingi na nguzo ya usasa.

discourses.source_txt: Abrams (1993) maintains that modernity is used to describe and identify new features of themes, genres, concepts, and literary styles associated with the first decades of the twentieth century, that is, after the Second World War. Abrams further emphasizes that the characteristics referred to vary depending on the critics involved.
discourses.translated_txt: Abrams (1993) anasisitiza kwamba uandishi wa kisasa hutumika kuelezea na kubainisha sifa mpya za dhamira, aina, dhana, na mitindo ya kifasihi inayohusishwa na miongo ya kwanza ya karne ya ishirini, yaani, baada ya Vita vya Pili vya Dunia. Abrams anaongeza kuwa sifa zinazorejelewa hubadilika kulingana na wakosoaji wanaohusika.

discourses.source_txt: Wamitila (2007) states, “Despite these differences, most critics agree that the foundation of these features is a departure from the traditional foundations of art and Western or pre-existing culture.”
discourses.translated_txt: Wamitila (2007) anasema, “Licha ya tofauti hizi, wakosoaji wengi wanakubaliana kwamba msingi wa sifa hizi ni kuondoka kutoka kwa misingi ya jadi ya sanaa na utamaduni wa Magharibi au uliokuwepo awali.”

discourses.source_txt: According to this, it is evident that modernity completely broke away from the conventions of literary composition that were followed before the twentieth century. Although the exact time of the emergence of modernity and modernism is a matter of debate, it is clear that modernism arose and was built on the foundations of modernity. Modernism emerged and was established in the twentieth century.
discourses.translated_txt: Kulingana na hili, ni wazi kwamba usasa ulijitenga kabisa na mila za uandishi wa fasihi zilizofuatwa kabla ya karne ya ishirini. Ingawa wakati halisi wa kuzuka kwa usasa na usanifu wa kisasa ni suala lenye mjadala, ni dhahiri kwamba usanifu wa kisasa uliibuka na kujengwa juu ya misingi ya usasa. Usanifu wa kisasa uliibuka na kuthibitishwa katika karne ya ishirini.

discourses.source_txt: It was associated with Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, among others.
discourses.translated_txt: Ilihusishwa na Nietzsche, Heidegger, Derrida, Lyotard, Baudrillard, miongoni mwa wengine.

discourses.source_txt: Other scholars who have contributed to the theory of modernism include Jurgen Habermas (1987), who emphasizes that the contemporary world relies more on aspects of modernism, in which all activities related to modern human beings are examined through multiple narratives.
discourses.translated_txt: Wanazuoni wengine ambao wamechangia kwenye nadharia ya umoderinishaji ni pamoja na Jurgen Habermas (1987), ambaye anasisitiza kwamba ulimwengu wa kisasa unategemea zaidi vipengele vya umoderinishaji, ambamo shughuli zote zinazohusiana na binadamu wa kisasa zinachunguzwa kupitia simulizi nyingi.

discourses.source_txt: A recent interpreter of this theory is Fredric Jameson (1991). This article focuses on various views of the theory as established by Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), and others.
discourses.translated_txt: Mfafanuzi wa hivi karibuni wa nadharia hii ni Fredric Jameson (1991). Makala hii inazingatia mitazamo mbalimbali ya nadharia hii kama ilivyoanzishwa na Jean-Francois Lyotard (1984), Jean Baudrillard (1994), Fredric Jameson (1991), na wengine.

discourses.source_txt: Lyotard (1984) maintains the controversial theory that the consciousness of members of society has been greatly transformed by the changes brought about by the industrial development period. This situation has led society to change its cultures and embrace modernist cultures.
discourses.translated_txt: Lyotard (1984) anashikilia nadharia yenye utata kwamba fahamu za wanajamii zimebadilika sana kutokana na mabadiliko yaliyoletwa na kipindi cha maendeleo ya viwanda. Hali hii imesababisha jamii kubadili tamaduni zake na kukumbatia tamaduni za kimodernisti.

discourses.source_txt: The modernist period disrupted the boundaries established by traditional culture. This phenomenon has manifested in various aspects of society, including literature.
discourses.translated_txt: Kipindi cha umoderani kilivuruga mipaka iliyowekwa na utamaduni wa jadi. Jambo hili limejitokeza katika nyanja mbalimbali za jamii, ikiwa ni pamoja na fasihi.

discourses.source_txt: Life and people are not orderly, and therefore literary works should not have any particular order. Modernism is closely associated with popular culture, where people do things in whatever way they wish without following traditional norms.
discourses.translated_txt: Maisha na watu si wa mpangilio, na hivyo kazi za fasihi hazipaswi kuwa na mpangilio maalum. Umoderno umehusishwa kwa karibu na utamaduni maarufu, ambapo watu hufanya mambo kwa njia yoyote wanayotaka bila kufuata desturi za jadi.

discourses.source_txt: The writer gives himself permission to use another artist’s work to create a new one.
discourses.translated_txt: Mwandishi anajipa ruhusa ya kutumia kazi ya msanii mwingine kuunda kazi mpya.

discourses.source_txt: With regard to these issues, this article has identified the types of texts referenced by the author K.W. Wamitila in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi to present the theme of oppression. Furthermore, it has analyzed how these texts were used in conveying the theme of oppression. This research focused on the aspect of intertextuality.
discourses.translated_txt: Kuhusiana na masuala haya, makala hii imetambua aina za maandishi yaliyotajwa na mwandishi K.W. Wamitila katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi ili kuwasilisha dhamira ya uonevu. Zaidi ya hayo, imeshughulikia jinsi maandishi haya yalivyotumika katika kuwasilisha dhamira ya uonevu. Utafiti huu umejikita katika kipengele cha mtindo wa maandishi mbalimbali (intertextuality).

discourses.source_txt: Carter (2006) explains that modernism violates all conventions and rules of composition. The rules Carter refers to may be structural or linguistic.
discourses.translated_txt: Carter (2006) anaeleza kuwa uanamitindo wa kisasa unakiuka kanuni na sheria zote za uundaji. Sheria ambazo Carter anazirejelea zinaweza kuwa za kimuundo au za lugha.

discourses.source_txt: This is to say that, along with popular literature, modernism is also associated with popular performance.
discourses.translated_txt: Hii ni kusema kwamba, pamoja na fasihi maarufu, usasa pia unahusishwa na uigizaji maarufu.

discourses.source_txt: One well-known feature in popular literature is the “stream of consciousness,” which is a narrative technique in prose writing that employs lengthy descriptions focusing on the thoughts passing through a character’s mind (Wamitila, 2006).
discourses.translated_txt: Kipengele kimoja kinachojulikana sana katika fasihi maarufu ni "mto wa fikra," ambacho ni mbinu ya uandishi wa tamthilia inayotumia maelezo marefu yanayolenga mawazo yanayopita katika akili ya mhusika (Wamitila, 2006).

discourses.source_txt: This performance takes place anywhere and does not follow any particular order. Often, the writer’s main goal is simply to entertain society.
discourses.translated_txt: Onyesho hili hufanyika mahali popote na halifuati mpangilio maalum wowote. Mara nyingi, lengo kuu la mwandishi ni kuburudisha jamii tu.

discourses.source_txt: Popular performance uses popular language.
discourses.translated_txt: Utendaji maarufu hutumia lugha maarufu.

discourses.source_txt: Since language is an important tool in literary writing, modernism focuses on the use of language in a very free manner without adhering to its fluency or standardization. It also involves mixing different languages, for example, English and Swahili or first languages and Swahili. This concept guided this research in analyzing specific issues concerning the use of popular language, especially code-mixing and code-switching in the novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. The language used refers to various texts that present the theme of oppression in society. The foundation of modernism was employed to guide the research in the analysis of intertextuality as one of the key elements of experimental novels. The researcher has identified how this element disrupts order in the selected novel.
discourses.translated_txt: Kwa kuwa lugha ni chombo muhimu katika uandishi wa fasihi, usasa unalenga matumizi ya lugha kwa njia huru sana bila kuzingatia ufasaha au viwango vyake. Pia unahusisha uchanganyaji wa lugha mbalimbali, kwa mfano, Kiingereza na Kiswahili au lugha za kwanza na Kiswahili. Dhana hii iliongoza utafiti huu kuchunguza masuala mahususi kuhusu matumizi ya lugha maarufu, hasa uchanganyaji lugha na ubadilishaji wa msimbo katika riwaya ya Msichana wa Mbalamwezi. Lugha iliyotumiwa inarejelea maandishi mbalimbali yanayowasilisha dhamira ya ukandamizaji katika jamii. Msingi wa usasa ulitumiwa kuongoza utafiti katika uchambuzi wa uhusiano wa maandishi kama mojawapo ya vipengele muhimu vya riwaya za majaribio. Mtafiti ametambua jinsi kipengele hiki kinavyovuruga mpangilio katika riwaya iliyoteuliwa.

discourses.source_txt:
1.4 Intertextuality

Intertextuality is the translation of the English term “intertextuality,” which was first used by the French philosopher Julia Kristeva in her book ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). According to Kristeva, every word is a reference to other words. Thus, emphasis is placed on the idea that texts are related to and depend on one another to create meaning.
discourses.translated_txt:
1.4 Intertekstualiti

Intertekstualiti ni tafsiri ya neno la Kiingereza “intertextuality,” ambalo lilitumiwa kwanza na mwanafalsafa wa Kifaransa Julia Kristeva katika kitabu chake ‘Dialogue and Novel’ (1966). Kwa mujibu wa Kristeva, kila neno ni rejea kwa maneno mengine. Hivyo, msisitizo umewekwa kwenye wazo kwamba maandishi yanahusiana na kutegemeana ili kuunda maana.

discourses.source_txt: Stam (2000), as quoted in Anderson (2004:1), states, “Any emerging text must inevitably coexist with another, or with other texts with which the original has also coexisted.”
discourses.translated_txt: Stam (2000), kama alivyonukuliwa katika Anderson (2004:1), anasema, “Kila maandishi yanayochipuka lazima yaishi pamoja na maandishi mengine, au na maandishi mengine ambayo ya awali pia yameishi pamoja nayo.”

discourses.source_txt: This statement demonstrates that a literary work does not originate solely from the mind of the author or from a vacuum, but is instead a collection of different texts.
discourses.translated_txt: Kauli hii inaonyesha kwamba kazi ya fasihi haitokani tu na akili ya mwandishi au kwenye ombwe, bali ni mkusanyiko wa maandishi tofauti tofauti.

discourses.source_txt: (Anderson, 2004) claims that intertextuality involves “that which has already been said.” Intertextuality is an important element of modernism, in which Wamitila writes.
discourses.translated_txt: (Anderson, 2004) anadai kwamba maandishi yanahusisha “kile ambacho tayari kimesemwa.” Maandishi ni kipengele muhimu cha usasa, ambapo Wamitila anaandika.

discourses.source_txt: In addition, intertextuality is one of the key elements of experimental writing. 1.5 Intertextual References and the Presentation of the Theme of Oppression in the Novel Msichana wa Mbalamwezi: A Modernist Perspective

Developing countries oppress their citizens in various ways. These methods are especially apparent in the manner in which services are delivered. For various reasons, which artists themselves may possess, such oppression is creatively presented through literature. To fully express this situation, narrative techniques and literary devices are employed with skill and artistry.

discourses.source_txt: Njogu (1987) found in his study that the lower class (those living in Madongokuinama) constantly fight against the elite. Contrary to this study, the oppressed appear to accept their situation.
discourses.translated_txt: Njogu (1987) aligundua katika utafiti wake kwamba tabaka la chini (wale wanaoishi Madongokuinama) hupigana mara kwa mara dhidi ya tabaka la juu. Kinyume na utafiti huu, waliodhulumiwa wanaonekana kukubali hali yao.

discourses.source_txt: Moreover, they accept being “used” by the elite in exchange for small items such as alcohol. Those in power abuse their authority to harm others who are in the lower class.
discourses.translated_txt: Zaidi ya hayo, wanakubali "kutumiwa" na wasomi kwa kubadilishana na vitu vidogo kama vile pombe. Walioko madarakani wanatumia vibaya mamlaka yao kuwadhuru wengine walioko katika tabaka la chini.

discourses.source_txt: Extreme oppression is when the writer says that it is enough for the police chief to simply know about a certain “operation.”
discourses.translated_txt: Ukandamizaji mkubwa ni pale mwandishi anaposema kuwa inatosha kwa mkuu wa polisi kujua tu kuhusu “operesheni” fulani.

discourses.source_txt: This is contrary to the expectations of the community.
discourses.translated_txt: Hii ni kinyume na matarajio ya jamii.

discourses.source_txt: This is consistent with Kamunde’s (1983) observation that members of the lower class are oppressed by those of the upper class, although they eventually become aware of this and fight for their rights.
discourses.translated_txt: Hii inalingana na uchunguzi wa Kamunde (1983) kwamba wanachama wa tabaka la chini wanakandamizwa na wale wa tabaka la juu, ingawa hatimaye wanatambua hili na kupigania haki zao.

discourses.source_txt:
1.6 Conclusion  
This article has established that meaning, values, and truth are attained without relying on a single method or perspective, because their true source is society. Oppression in society has been presented through the use of intertextuality, which is an aspect of experimental writing.
discourses.translated_txt:
1.6 Hitimisho  
Makala haya imebainisha kwamba maana, maadili, na ukweli vinapatikana bila kutegemea mbinu au mtazamo mmoja pekee, kwa sababu chanzo chao halisi ni jamii. Ukandamizaji katika jamii umeoneshwa kupitia matumizi ya mwingiliano wa maandishi, ambao ni kipengele cha uandishi wa majaribio.

discourses.source_txt: Various texts, including those of a philosophical, religious, academic, and political nature, have been used to convey the theme of oppression in the novel *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*.
discourses.translated_txt: Maandishi mbalimbali, yakiwemo ya kifalsafa, kidini, kitaaluma, na kisiasa, yametumika kuwasilisha mada ya ukandamizaji katika riwaya ya *Msichana wa Mbalamwezi*.

discourses.source_txt: The author has used short narratives with specific intertextual references to illustrate how members of the community are denied their rights.
discourses.translated_txt: Mwandishi ametumia hadithi fupi zenye marejeo mahususi ya maandishi mengine ili kuonyesha jinsi wanajamii wanavyonyimwa haki zao.

discourses.source_txt: Similarly, it has become evident that the lack of order in modern life is reflected in modern literature. However, although the disorder in carrying out various activities may appear inadequate, it is sufficient in literature. This inadequacy is in fact a true representation of modern life, that is, a complete image of today’s society.
discourses.translated_txt: Vivyo hivyo, imekuwa dhahiri kwamba ukosefu wa utaratibu katika maisha ya kisasa unaonekana pia katika fasihi ya kisasa. Hata hivyo, ingawa vurugu katika utekelezaji wa shughuli mbalimbali inaweza kuonekana haitoshi, inatosha katika fasihi. Upungufu huu kwa hakika ni uwakilishi halisi wa maisha ya kisasa, yani picha kamili ya jamii ya leo.

discourses.source_txt: The current Swahili novel is appropriate because it serves as a true reflection of today’s society. It has become evident that short narratives referring to different texts are effective in presenting themes, rather than using a single long story written in the style of realism.
discourses.translated_txt: Riwaya ya Kiswahili ya sasa inafaa kwa sababu inaakisi kwa ukweli jamii ya leo. Imebainika kwamba hadithi fupi zinazoelezea maandishi mbalimbali zina ufanisi katika kuwasilisha dhamira, badala ya kutumia hadithi moja ndefu iliyoandikwa kwa mtindo wa uhalisia.

discourses.source_txt: Any creator has the freedom to try new methods in carrying out their work without being restricted or fixated on traditional rules. Therefore, a writer of literary works has the freedom to experiment with new approaches to writing without being constrained by traditional techniques that are rooted in realism.
discourses.translated_txt: Muumba yeyote ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya katika kutekeleza kazi yao bila kuzuiliwa au kushikamana na kanuni za jadi. Hivyo basi, mwandishi wa kazi za fasihi ana uhuru wa kujaribu mbinu mpya za uandishi bila kufungwa na mbinu za jadi ambazo zina mizizi katika uhalisia.

discourses.source_txt: However, there is a risk that reading and understanding the modern novel requires prior knowledge of many issues related to philosophy, various disciplines, religion, politics, popular language, and others.
discourses.translated_txt: Hata hivyo, kuna hatari kwamba kusoma na kuelewa riwaya ya kisasa kunahitaji maarifa ya awali kuhusu masuala mengi yanayohusiana na falsafa, taaluma mbalimbali, dini, siasa, lugha maarufu, na mengineyo.
